name: yushin-saas
description: Yushin TCM-intaketool — multi-tenant SaaS-versie (Render Node + Postgres + Mollie). Cloudflare Worker/D1-scripts hieronder blijven staan als terugvaloptie, zie migrations/ vs migrations-postgres/.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0002_password_reset.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0003_user_deactivation.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0004_access_codes.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0005_audit_log.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0006_patient_intake_tokens.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0007_trial_session_limit.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --local --file=./migrations/0008_session_feedback.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0002_password_reset.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0003_user_deactivation.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0004_access_codes.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0005_audit_log.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0006_patient_intake_tokens.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0007_trial_session_limit.sql && wrangler d1 execute yushin-db --remote --file=./migrations/0008_session_feedback.sql
scripts.test:client: node client/smoke-test.mjs && node client/integration-test.mjs && node client/dashboard-smoke-test.mjs
